page_description: Add a taxpayer by tax ID. The engagement opens once the taxpayer approves via the link sent by email.
form_description: Enter the details; a consent link is sent to the taxpayer's contact address.
form_tax_id_hint: 10-digit VKN for a legal entity; 11-digit TCKN or a VKN for an individual.
form_tax_id_invalid: Enter a 10-digit VKN or an 11-digit TCKN.
form_title_required: Enter a company name or full name.
form_email_hint: The consent link is sent to this address.
sent_title: Consent request sent to the taxpayer
sent_description: Consent request sent to the taxpayer. The engagement opens once the taxpayer approves.
list_description: Add-taxpayer requests your office sent, and their status.
cancel_description: The consent link stops working. You can send a new request later if needed.
consent_title: {{office}} wants to add you as a taxpayer
consent_description: {{office}} asks for your consent to open an engagement for {{name}}.
consent_effect: If you approve, this office can access your company's financial records. An engagement with another office, if any, ends.
privacy_notice_label: I have read the Privacy Notice and have been informed about how my personal data will be processed.
privacy_notice_hint: For how your personal data is processed, see the
consent_sign_in_hint: To answer, sign in with {{email}} or create an account for that address.
consent_sign_out: Sign out and use the right account
consent_wrong_account: You are signed in as {{current}}. The request was sent to {{email}}.
consent_reject_description: The office sees that the request was rejected and no engagement opens.
consent_approved_toast: You approved the request; the engagement is open.
consent_forwarded_description: Your approval was forwarded to your company's authorized users; they can approve it from the taxpayer panel.
consent_rejected_description: The office was notified; no engagement was opened.
consent_not_found_description: The link is invalid or no longer available.
consent_error_description: Something went wrong while checking the request. Please try again.
consent_status_expired: The request has expired. Ask your office for a new one.
panel_description: Offices asking to add your company as a taxpayer. Approving opens the engagement.
panel_approve_description: This office can access your company's financial records. An engagement with another office, if any, ends.
panel_toast_approved: You approved the request; the engagement is open.
form_activity_code_hint: 6 digits, e.g. 47.11.01. Leave empty if unknown.
form_activity_code_invalid: The activity code must have 6 digits (e.g. 47.11.01).
cert_description: Upload a photo of the certificate or the e-certificate PDF; the details go into the form. Nothing is saved: check the fields and request consent.
cert_done: Certificate read. Review the fields and request consent.
cert_done_check: Certificate read. Look at the fields marked "Check" and request consent.
cert_problem_missing: Could not be read; enter it by hand.
cert_problem_low_confidence: Not sure; compare with the certificate.
cert_problem_invalid: The value read is invalid (e.g. the tax ID check digit fails); correct it from the certificate.
cert_error_off: Tax certificate reading is turned off in office settings. Fill the form by hand.
cert_error_ai: AI is not available right now. Fill the form by hand.
cert_error_file: This file cannot be read. Upload a JPEG or PNG photo or a PDF.
cert_error_scanned_pdf: This PDF is a scanned image with no text. Upload a photo (JPEG or PNG) of the certificate.
cert_error_heic: HEIC photos cannot be read. Save the photo as JPEG or take a screenshot and upload it.
cert_error_unreadable: The certificate could not be read. Try a sharper photo or fill the form by hand.
cert_error_rate: Too many certificates were read in a short time. Wait a little and try again.
cert_error_generic: The certificate could not be read. Try again or fill the form by hand.
